args.title: Triage issue #4423: update index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: The `pickLocale` function in `src/i18n/index.ts` iterates through the comma-separated parts of the Accept-Language header and returns the first supported language it encounters, ignoring any quality value (`q`) weights (e.g. `q=0.9` vs `q=0.3`).

label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `pickLocale` function in `src/i18n/index.ts` iterates through the comma-separated parts of the Accept-Language header and returns the first supported language it encounters, ignoring any quality value (`q`) weights (e.g. `q=0.9` vs `q=0.3`).
